claudeMd:
# My video work

I edit video. You can use editing terms normally: cut, timeline, B-roll, color, captions, render, hook. When I send a transcript, help me find the best parts for clips, put the video in order and write the title, description and captions. Whenever you can, include timecodes (minute:second) so I can find things quickly on the timeline.
primeiraVitoria: Let's do the first real task now: my next video. Ask me the topic and who it's for. Then give me 3 title options, the hook for the first 3 seconds and a script of up to 30 seconds, the way I would say it. Save it all in a note in my second brain.
semana: Turn a long video (or its transcript) into ideas for short clips, with the best part of each.
Write the description and captions for a video I've already recorded.
Make a list of 10 topics for the coming weeks based on my audience's questions.
Review a script of mine and cut what isn't needed, without losing the way I talk.
Plan a series of 3 videos that tell a story in parts.
Note in my second brain what worked in this week's videos, to use as a reference.
